list.name: baseline_eval_run_id
list.label: Baseline Eval Run
list.query: SELECT eval_run_id::text AS __value, to_char(started_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || '  ' || eval_run_id::text AS __text FROM diagnostics.eval_run_summaries WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at DESC

list.name: candidate_eval_run_id
list.label: Candidate Eval Run
list.query: SELECT eval_run_id::text AS __value, to_char(started_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || '  ' || eval_run_id::text AS __text FROM diagnostics.eval_run_summaries WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at DESC

targets.rawSql: WITH b AS (SELECT * FROM diagnostics.eval_run_summaries WHERE eval_run_id = '${baseline_eval_run_id}'::uuid), c AS (SELECT * FROM diagnostics.eval_run_summaries WHERE eval_run_id = '${candidate_eval_run_id}'::uuid) SELECT field, baseline, candidate FROM (VALUES (1, 'eval_run_id', (SELECT eval_run_id::text FROM b), (SELECT eval_run_id::text FROM c)), (2, 'run_type', (SELECT run_type FROM b), (SELECT run_type FROM c)), (3, 'started_at', (SELECT started_at::text FROM b), (SELECT started_at::text FROM c)), (4, 'iterations_evaluated_count', (SELECT iterations_evaluated_count::text FROM b), (SELECT iterations_evaluated_count::text FROM c)), (5, 'judge_model', (SELECT judge_model FROM b), (SELECT judge_model FROM c)), (6, 'query_structuring_model', (SELECT runtime_query_structuring_model FROM b), (SELECT runtime_query_structuring_model FROM c)), (7, 'observation_boundary_resolver_model', (SELECT runtime_observation_boundary_resolver_model FROM b), (SELECT runtime_observation_boundary_resolver_model FROM c)), (8, 'observation_extraction_model', (SELECT runtime_observation_extraction_model FROM b), (SELECT runtime_observation_extraction_model FROM c)), (9, 'llm_structured_generation_model', (SELECT runtime_llm_structured_generation_model FROM b), (SELECT runtime_llm_structured_generation_model FROM c))) AS t(ord, field, baseline, candidate) ORDER BY ord
